meta.what: CK3 accolade attributes (Tours & Tournaments) with their per-level effects, what to read at battle time, the Bannerlord mapping of each attribute level, and the glory write-back.

model.attributes: An accolade has up to 3 attributes (NAccolade.ACCOLADE_MAX_TYPES) of 3 levels each. Each accolade rank (1..6, glory thresholds below) lets the owner add an attribute or raise one by a level, so the levels of all attributes sum to at most the rank; losing a rank disables one level (game concept accolade_rank). The first attribute is the primary one (initial_type; it only names the accolade); primary and secondary attributes work the same.
model.level_blocks: ranks = { 1 = {...} 2 = {...} 3 = {...} } of an attribute are its levels 1..3, not glory values (the .info file's glory-keyed example is outdated). INFERRED: only the highest unlocked level's modifiers apply (not cumulative): several attributes repeat the same value at every level (horse_archer screen 0.25 at levels 1-3, elephantry damage 0.2 at levels 2-3), which only makes sense if each level replaces the previous one. Parameters are checked with has_accolade_parameter over all unlocked levels, and vanilla picks the highest of low/medium/high itself.
model.knight_army_modifier: applies to the army the acclaimed knight is in (accolade_type.info). Liege modifiers apply to the owner. No 1.20 attribute uses knight_modifier, terrain_bonus, winter_bonus or holding_bonus (kept in the schema for patches).
model.active: Only active accolades (owner.any_active_accolade, max_active_accolades) give bonuses.
model.max_one_maa_attribute: An accolade may hold only one men_at_arms attribute (single_maa_attribute_allowance in the fit triggers).

acclaimed_fate.combat_phase: knight_none chance x1.25 for acclaimed knights (00_knight_phase_events.txt:17-19): fewer combat-phase events of any kind; as the victim of berserker/shieldmaiden attacks they are picked x0.75.
acclaimed_fate.post_battle: combat_event.1001 (on_combat_end_winner, runs after force_win): acclaimed commanders get +500 on the 90 "no effect" weight vs 10 capture (events/war_events/combat_events.txt:663-664); acclaimed knights capture x0.1 (:853-854) and death x0.5 (:944-945).
acclaimed_fate.bridge_rule: For heroes the BL battle downed, the bridge rolls the CK3 fate itself (FateResolver): multiply the wounded/maimed/killed weights of an acclaimed knight by 0.8 against the unchanged "nothing" outcome when the fate model has one, else killed and maimed weights by 0.8 (1/1.25), and capture probability by 0.1 (knights) or 10/600 / (10/100) = 0.17 (commanders).

per_character.script: accolade_rank >= n (also usable as a value: save_scope_value_as = { name = x value = accolade_rank }, vanilla 00_accolade_interactions.txt:88-89)
none (no trigger, link or script value); rank + rank_thresholds bound it

record_proposal.status: PROPOSAL - not emitted by the mod yet; owner: CK3 mod generator (tools/gen/gen_ck3_mod.mjs). Parsers already ignore unknown CX/AX fields (BattleSnapshotBuilder.CharacterFact/ArmyFact), so adding the lines cannot break the bridge.
record_proposal.where: After the CX lines of every C record (any role: an acclaimed knight may also be an army commander), in that character's scope; AX|uncontrolled after the AX lines of every A/J army.

records.CX|acc_active|yes|no: is_acclaimed = yes and the accolade is one of its owner's active accolades (accolade_owner.any_active_accolade). Inactive accolades give no bonuses.
records.CX|acc_type|<type>|<0..3>: one line per has_accolade_type (triggers.log:11455) with the level from accolade_attribute_level = { type = <type> level >= n } (triggers.log:11414).
records.AX|uncontrolled|yes|no: army scope: location.barony_controller (event_targets.log:1536) is not the army_owner. Only needed for marauder_attribute (uncontrolled_province_advantage).

record_proposal.no_glory_value: The accolade's current glory has no trigger or script value in triggers.log/event_targets.log. The rank (with glory.rank_thresholds) bounds it; var:lifetime_glory on the accolade is vanilla bookkeeping of the net change under the current knight (reset at succession), not the glory.

elephant_cavalry.note: no elephants in Bannerlord: heavy cavalry substitute, tier measured against armored_horsemen

gunpowder.note: no single-player firearms: crossbow substitute; ref crossbowmen sits at tier 4.6 on the archer scale

siege_weapon.note: fights_in_main_phase = no for all 9 siege MaA: never spawned in a field battle

modes.tier: DEFAULT, bridge only (works with the current module): add tierDelta to the resolved tier of every matching group before TroopResolver picks rungs (same rule as the MaA tier rule: tier = ref + log2((damage/ref)(toughness/ref)), i.e. delta = log2((1+damage_mult)(1+toughness_mult))). Clamp the result to the ladder like any tier; above the top rung the agent multiplier (2^(over/2), cap 2) applies as for every MaA.
modes.agent: Module stat model (when available): damageMult on the outgoing damage of agents of matching groups (CK3ApplyDamageModel : CustomAgentApplyDamageModel, override ApplyGeneralDamageModifiers, AttackInformation.AttackerAgent -> group), healthMult on their HealthLimit/Health at spawn (as heroes' healthMultiplier). K = 0.5 of the CK3 multiplier (INFERRED, calibrate). Never both modes for the same group.
modes.writeback: pursuitMult / screenMult multiply the ck3_catalog pursuit / screen of the matching MaA in the bridge's casualty conversion (CasualtyModel), independent of the mode.

bannerlord.matching_groups: A level effect with scope maa_base_type covers the request groups maa:<maaKey>#<armyTag>#<regimentId> whose ck3_catalog maa_types[maaKey].base_type is the baseType and whose armyTag is the acclaimed knight's ck3xbl_c_army (knights) or his army (commanders). scope army covers levy#<armyTag> and every maa:*#<armyTag>#*. A knight with c_army = 0 buffs nothing.
bannerlord.captain: The acclaimed knight captains the formation of his linked groups (bannerlord.captain per type). Stock GeneralsAndCaptainsAssignmentLogic (TaleWorlds.MountAndBlade.dll) assigns heroes by Character.GetPower() to the largest formation whose mounted-ness matches the hero (PickBestRegularFormationToLead, protected virtual) and sets formation.Captain. Proposal for the module: optional HeroSpec field captainOf (FormationClass name); a subclass overriding PickBestRegularFormationToLead returns that formation first. Without module support the bridge may set HeroSpec.formation to the class (default_group) and, for a foot formation, Horse/HorseHarness = "" so the stock logic can match him.
bannerlord.rank_presence: INFERRED design (no CK3 counterpart): every agent of the formation an ACTIVE acclaimed knight captains gets initial morale +2 x accolade rank (rank 1..6 -> +2..+12; Bannerlord initial morale is 35 + random 0..29 + additions, clamped 15..100, CommonAIComponent.InitializeMorale), applied with Agent.ChangeMorale (AgentComponentExtensions) once the captain is assigned (OnDeploymentFinished) and to reinforcements of that formation as they spawn.

glory.rank_thresholds_source: common/defines/00_defines.txt:1755 (NAccolade.ACCOLADE_GLORY_LEVELS; rank n needs thresholds[n-1] glory)

succession_glory_loss.honourable_deaths_skip_it: common/on_action/accolade_on_actions.txt on_accolade_new_acclaimed_knight: no loss when the old knight died with death_reason death_battle (the mod's battle deaths use it) and similar

battle_sources.meaning: a berserker knight (root) attacks an enemy knight; the ATTACKED knight's accolade gains (as written in 1.20)
root turns berserker in battle; root's own accolade gains
a shieldmaiden (root) attacks an enemy knight; the ATTACKED knight's accolade gains (as written in 1.20)
root is wounded by an enemy knight; the wounding knight's accolade gains
root is maimed by an enemy knight; the maiming knight's accolade gains
root is killed by an enemy knight; the killing knight's accolade gains (if acclaimed)
root is killed; root's own accolade gains (after death = { }), so the successor inherits it
battle won: every acclaimed side knight and side commander of the winning side (fired by on_combat_end_winner)
battle won: every acclaimed side knight and side commander of the winning side (fired by on_combat_end_winner)
battle lost: every acclaimed side knight and side commander of the losing side (fired by on_combat_end_loser)
battle lost: every acclaimed side knight and side commander of the losing side (fired by on_combat_end_loser)

write_back.effect: add_glory = <value or script value block> in accolade scope (effects.log:15972; block form as in common/scripted_effects/00_accolades_scripted_effects.txt:371). Guard like vanilla: is_acclaimed = yes, then accolade = { add_glory = ... } (accolade_minimal_glory_gain_with_checks_effect, :1648).
write_back.automatic: Do NOT send battle-outcome glory: vanilla on_combat_end_winner/loser fire combat_event.2101 (+25 minor_glory_gain to every acclaimed knight and commander of the winner) and combat_event.2111 (-10 minimal_glory_loss for the loser) after the mod's force_win (PROTOCOL 10.5). Outcome 3 (abort) has no winner, so no outcome glory.

per_knight_rule.hero_downs: for every enemy hero whose result killedBy is this acclaimed knight: CK3 fate killed -> +25 (minor_glory_gain, as knight_killed :1265), wounded / maimed / captured -> +10 (minimal_glory_gain, as knight_wounded :741 and knight_maimed :952)
per_knight_rule.troop_kills: min(25, round(2 * sqrt(kills - hero downs))) (INFERRED: vanilla has no per-soldier glory; 4 kills -> 4, 30 -> 11, 100 -> 20; never more than one minor gain)
per_knight_rule.own_death: +25 when his own CK3 fate is killed (knight_killed :1344 adds minor_glory_gain to the dying knight's accolade); the successor keeps it and death_battle avoids the succession loss

write_back.registers: PROPOSAL (owner: CK3 mod, tools/gen/lib/registers.mjs): 8 glory pairs (character tag, 1000 + glory) in the free registers r122..r129 and r190..r197; r198 stays free. The checksum already covers r0..r198. Apply them before the character slots (snippet tools/gen/knights/ck3_accolade_emit_snippet.txt).
write_back.related: Prestige for kills (knight_prestige_gain_on_kill) and knight_increase_prowess_chance_effect are the other write-back items of backlog item 6; acclaimed_knight_prestige_from_victory is automatic (parameters table).

modifier_kinds.maa_stat: knight_army_modifier on one MaA base type of the army the acclaimed knight is in: damage/toughness -> Bannerlord buff of that army's MaA groups of the base type (tier or agent multipliers); pursuit/screen -> the bridge's casualty conversion (write-back side).
modifier_kinds.army_stat: knight_army_modifier on every regiment of the knight's army (levies and MaA): damage/toughness -> Bannerlord buff of all CK3 troop groups of that army.
modifier_kinds.counter_efficiency: CK3 counter strength of the army's MaA: optional module damage bonus of that army's MaA agents against agents of base types their CK3 MaA counter (ck3_catalog maa_types[].counters). No tier equivalent.
modifier_kinds.advantage_uncontrolled: Advantage while in a province the army owner does not control: feeds the commander-advantage mechanic of the mapper for the knight's side (needs the proposed AX|uncontrolled line).
modifier_kinds.siege: Siege value: no effect (sieges stay in CK3, PROTOCOL section 0).
modifier_kinds.strategic: Map movement, attrition or siege timing: no effect on a field battle.
modifier_kinds.economy: Liege MaA economy (regiment cap, maintenance): no battle effect; the extra regiments already show in the army snapshot.
modifier_kinds.skill: Liege skill modifier: already contained in the logged CK3 skill values (C record ck3xbl_c_martial etc.).
modifier_kinds.knight_effectiveness: Liege modifier on all of his knights: belongs in the knight-effectiveness reconstruction (bridge/data/ck3_knight_effectiveness_sources.json, backlog item 4).
modifier_kinds.knight_count: More knights for the liege: already visible as more C|KNIGHT records.

accolade_increase_hostile_knight_death_l.note: Chance factor of event knight_killed for every knight of the OTHER side while this side has a knight or commander with the parameter; only the highest of low/medium/high applies.

accolade_defends_family_low.note: Chance factor of knight_wounded, knight_maimed and knight_killed for knights of the same side whose house is the liege's house; only the highest of low/medium/high applies.

acclaimed_knight_prestige_from_victory.note: Vanilla on_combat_end_winner; runs by itself after the mod's force_win. Nothing to do.

acclaimed_knight_piety_from_battle.note: Read at war end (religious war casus belli, alliance interactions), not per battle.
